mechanism: Sumatriptan is a 5-HT1B/1D receptor agonist that may potentiate serotonergic effects of levodopa metabolism, and both agents can increase blood pressure through different mechanisms (sumatriptan via vasoconstriction, levodopa via dopaminergic stimulation).
action: Monitor blood pressure and cardiac status; use sumatriptan cautiously in patients on carbidopa-levodopa; consider alternative migraine therapy if possible, and counsel on symptoms of serotonin syndrome.
